# Ravjoth Brar — AI Researcher & Student

> Ravjoth Brar is a student AI researcher at Haberdashers' Boys' School, London. He specialises in interpretable AI, RAG systems, LLM fine-tuning, and AI ethics & governance. He is an RAF Arkwright Engineering Scholar, Head Boy (School Captain), and a published researcher.

## About

Ravjoth Brar (also known as Ravjoth Singh Brar) is based in Barnet, London, UK. His research spans the technical and the philosophical: from engineering high-performance RAG systems and fine-tuning LLMs, to publishing work on neural interpretability in epilepsy and the ethics of AI consciousness. He has given a TEDx talk ("Is AI closer to God than humanity?") and co-founded Beri-Labs.

Contact: ravjoth.brar@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ravjothbrar/
GitHub: https://github.com/ravjothbrar
Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20798155
